original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚呼吁采取行动应对恐怖分子使用AI和无人机
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚国家反恐中心协调员在阿布贾举行的区域培训开幕式上，呼吁西非和萨赫勒地区加强合作，打击恐怖组织利用人工智能、无人机和虚拟资产进行宣传、招募和融资。非洲联盟反恐中心官员警告称，ISWAP、博科圣地和JNIM等组织正利用社交媒体、移动货币、加密货币和暗网扩大其影响力。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚呼吁加强区域努力，打击恐怖分子利用人工智能、无人机和虚拟资产进行宣传、招募和融资
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Nigeria has called for intensified regional efforts to disrupt terrorists’ exploitation of artificial intelligence (AI), drones and virtual assets for propaganda, recruitment and financing across West Africa and the Sahel.

key_facts.fact: 国家反恐中心协调员Adamu Laka少将在阿布贾发表讲话
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Maj.-Gen. Adamu Laka, National Coordinator of the National Counter Terrorism Centre (NCTC), Office of the National Security Adviser (ONSA), made the call on Tuesday in Abuja.

key_facts.fact: 非洲联盟反恐中心官员警告ISWAP、博科圣地和JNIM等组织正在扩大其影响力
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Lallali expressed concern that groups such as the Islamic State West Africa Province (ISWAP), Boko Haram and Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) were extending their reach beyond physical territories.
